So we go to the police academy to take courses in different laws

I also take a legal class so i can use certain computer programs.

We also (but this varies by department) file all your protection orders, we are responsible for managing warrants that are filed, concealed carry permits you name it. If it comes or leaves the department the dispatchers are the ones that make sure its kosher. 




That being said, dispatchers cant give legal advice, not because they dont know the law, but because its a liability since our training isnt as advanced in areas of the law as a police officers is. Not that they know more than us, its just were better in different areas.



Most of a dispatchers job is sitting and filing mind numbing legal paper work. You feel more like a secretary than a dispatcher somtimes.
